newsitem.title: JAPAN: Roland shares up on bright forecast.
newsitem.headline: Roland shares up on bright forecast.

text.p: Shares of Roland Co rose on Monday morning to a new high for this calendar year, helped by its bright earnings forecast released last week, brokers said.

The share price of Roland, which makes electronic keyboard musical instruments, briefly marked a new high for the year of 2,750. At 0129 GMT, the share was up 30 yen at 2,730, on volume of 88,000 shares.
On Wednesday, Roland forecast a group net profit of three billion yen for the year to March 31, 1998, up from an actual group net profit of 2.69 billion yen last year.
